full_name: Anthony Abraham Jack | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Shutzer Assistant Professor Harvard Graduate School of Education
bio: Anthony Abraham Jack is a junior fellow at the Harvard Society of Fellows and an assistant professor of education at the Harvard Graduate School of Education. He holds the Shutzer Assistant Professorship at Harvard Radcliffe Institute. Jack’s first book, The Privileged Poor: How Elite Colleges Are Failing Disadvantaged Students (Harvard University Press, 2019), was awarded a 2020 Mirra Komarovsky Book Award, a 2019 CEP Mildred García Award for Exemplary Scholarship, and the 2018 Thomas J. Wilson Memorial Prize.
